specification: Read counts.tsv (taxa as rows, samples as columns). Exclude any sample whose column is all zero. Compute Bray–Curtis dissimilarity on raw counts for every pair of remaining samples and report the mean, and the number of samples used.

Join counts.tsv rows to stations.csv by station ID, treating 'PB-07' and 'PB07' as the same ID (remove the hyphen). Ignore stations with no counts row. Run one-way PERMANOVA (Bray–Curtis on raw counts) with zone as the factor over all counted samples; report pseudo-F, R² and n.

If every core's 63–150 µm fraction was picked, sum each core's two fractions per taxon and compute Shannon (natural log). Otherwise the >63 µm assemblage is not observed for some cores: compute Shannon on the >150 µm fraction alone for every core in both campaigns. Report the mean per campaign.

Rename each counts.tsv column to its taxonomy.csv accepted_name (exact recorded string) and sum columns that share an accepted name. Richness is the number of accepted names with a nonzero total. Mean Bray–Curtis on the merged raw counts over all sample pairs.
